tools.name: viewer_get_state
tools.description: Return the current architecture inspection view, layers, cutaway, and deformation scale.

tools.name: viewer_reset
tools.description: Clear measurements and annotations, restore default layers, and return to the isometric view.

tools.name: sv3d_open_scene
tools.description: Report the already-opened architecture inspection scene.

tools.name: sv3d_orbit
tools.description: Point the inspection camera at an absolute azimuth/elevation around its current target.

tools.name: sv3d_set_view
tools.description: Switch the isometric, front, side, or top camera used for architecture inspection.

tools.name: sv3d_set_orthographic_view
tools.description: Switch to a true orthographic front, side, or top elevation with parallel projection, so measurements read without perspective distortion.

tools.name: viewer_zoom
tools.description: Set the architecture inspection zoom to an absolute multiple of the fitted view; 1 is fitted, 2 is twice as close.

tools.name: viewer_pan
tools.description: Pan the inspection camera to an absolute, radius-normalised look-at offset from the visible-scene centre along camera right/up.

tools.name: sv3d_toggle_layer
tools.description: Show or hide a named inspection layer. Ground-truth is unavailable in evaluation mode.

tools.name: sv3d_set_cutaway
tools.description: Set the cutaway plane along a chosen axis to expose internal inspection responses.

tools.name: sv3d_set_deformation_amplification
tools.description: Set the display-only displacement scale for registered deformed solids.

tools.name: viewer_pick_point
tools.description: Return the world point under a normalized viewport position, or wait for the expert to click visible geometry when no position is given.

tools.name: viewer_pick_vertex
tools.description: Return the existing area-measurement vertex nearest a normalized viewport position, or wait for the expert to click near one when no position is given. Used only to re-place a vertex of a recorded area measurement.

tools.name: sv3d_measure
tools.description: Measure the 3D distance between two points on the inspection scene.

tools.name: sv3d_fit_plane
tools.description: Fit a least-squares plane through three or more picked points on the inspection scene and report the departure of each point from it.

tools.name: sv3d_measure_area
tools.description: Measure the area enclosed by three or more picked points on the inspection scene. Reports the true fit-plane area, the areas projected onto the XY, XZ and YZ planes, the perimeter and the largest departure from the fit plane.

tools.name: sv3d_measure_angle
tools.description: Measure the angle at the vertex between the rays to the first and second points, in 3D and projected onto the horizontal plane.

tools.name: sv3d_clear_measurements
tools.description: Clear architecture inspection measurement overlays and results.

tools.name: sv3d_render
tools.description: Render the current architecture inspection view.

tools.name: sv3d_annotate
tools.description: Place a point annotation on visible inspection geometry.

tools.name: sv3d_save_operation_trace
tools.description: Return the recorded inspection operation trace without downloading a file.
